faqs.question: What's the difference between UI design and UX design?
faqs.answer: UX design decides how the product is structured and how people move through it — the flows, wireframes, and logic. UI design is the visible layer on top: the exact colours, typography, spacing, icons, and component styling of each screen. We offer both, and they work best together, but UI design specifically delivers the polished, final look your customers actually see.

faqs.question: Do you design the screens, or do you build the working website or app too?
faqs.answer: UI design delivers the visual design of every screen as files developers can build from. Many clients pair it with our website or app development so the same team designs and builds, but you're free to take the design files to your own developers. Either way the handover includes everything needed to build it faithfully.

faqs.question: Will the design work on mobile and in both Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design responsive screens for mobile, tablet, and desktop rather than one fixed size, so the interface holds up on real devices. Each screen is designed in both Arabic and English with proper right-to-left layouts, so the Arabic version reads naturally instead of looking like a mirrored afterthought.

faqs.question: Do we own the design files, and can we edit them later?
faqs.answer: Completely. You receive the full Figma source files, exported assets, and the design system at handover with no lock-in. Your team or any other designer can open, edit, and extend everything later without coming back to us for access.

faqs.question: Can we see the design direction before committing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start with a free consultation over WhatsApp, where we review your product and goals. Before you commit, we prepare a preview of the visual direction on a real screen — in Arabic and English — so you can judge the look and feel on something concrete rather than a description.
